speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Fish day. Sit. You are in the house, and the board is the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am sitting. I will eat.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is short again. The end is to the window, as she likes.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A finger and a half. A penny. The penny is the penny. Threepence for the board, when you have eaten it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Threepence. I am not leaving it in the pot.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: Good day. I am going to my own work. The name on the work is my name.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then go with it. I am not dressing your name in mine, and I am not dressing the door in more hawthorn.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One bough is still the allowance. I am not asking for a second.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I did not bring one. The shoes dried.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The firing is not on today's slate. Sixpence stays where it sleeps. Eat the fish.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am eating it. The page upstairs is the three breaths and a blank. That is the whole of my news, and it is not a sum.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then it is a cheap piece of news. Threepence. I have said it.
